subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should Himalaya remain a bundled starter skill with a narrow corrected documentation update, or should its maintained documentation move with the proposed externalization before broader guidance is added?
rationale: Current bundled docs remain user-facing, but the open maintainer-authored starter-set refactor proposes removing Himalaya from core; only maintainers can choose the durable owner and scope for broader email-composition policy.

options.title: Correct bundled docs while ownership is decided
options.body: Land a narrow verified correction for move/copy and export syntax, and defer broad HTML, deliverability, and provider-policy guidance until its owner is settled.

options.title: Externalize the skill first
options.body: Complete the Himalaya removal and publish or maintain the skill through the selected external package path, then carry the complete docs update there.

recommendation.title: Correct bundled docs while ownership is decided
recommendation.body: Land a narrow verified correction for move/copy and export syntax, and defer broad HTML, deliverability, and provider-policy guidance until its owner is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: Their issue review and prior work connect them to both the current bundled-skill documentation and the outstanding consolidation decision.
